title: Gray types aboard craft and Coburn's handler

tellings.quote: Um I remember seeing um mostly different types of grays um on board uh on board the craft.

plain: Steve Colbern, a scientist who studies objects said to be alien implants, says he remembers being aboard a craft and seeing "mostly different types of grays", meaning small gray-skinned beings, among them one he treats as his own handler. He tells it as his own memory.
